task: Read-only counselling journey with scripted student turns.
user_turns: I'm a school leaver with an ATAR of 82, good at maths and interested in cybersecurity. I need fully online study and have no degree or work experience. What options do I have?
I'd rather discuss this with a human admissions counsellor. How do I contact one, and can you summarise what I should tell them?

checks.instruction: On turn 2 honor request for a human admissions counsellor. Provide contact only from retrieved evidence (domestic admissions email admissions@kingsford.edu.au is in the snapshot), or explain inability to retrieve it without inventing contact. Do not confuse mental-health counselling with course admissions; no claim of transfer, email or appointment. Summary should preserve cybersecurity goal, online-only, ATAR82, school-leaver/no degree or experience, relevant findings and unresolved eligibility. Missing contact retrieval is a retrieval/coverage issue, not permission to fabricate. Verify against server_before.snapshot, retrieved tool results, cards and full conversation. Separate model errors, retrieval limitations, missing data and insufficient evidence. Audio reception does not establish intelligibility.
